## [1.8.1](https://github.com/GahahaWang/TWRailway-patch/compare/v1.8.0...v1.8.1) (2026-11-07)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* Hide the 喜歡這個App嗎 review dialog ([43a11f0](https://github.com/GahahaWang/TWRailway-patch/commit/43a11f0cde0abbfc4d5dec31ec3e980621ee0e7a))

apps.app_name: 火車時刻表-台鐵時刻表

patches.name: Expand search history
patches.description: Shows up to 20 recent searches instead of 3. The number can be changed in the patch settings.

patches.name: Fix recent apps title
patches.description: Shows the app name instead of "app.titleTra" as the app's title in the recent apps screen.

patches.name: Fix search history count
patches.description: Shows the expanded limit (such as "(5/20)") in the count next to 搜尋歷史, and removes the "升級" text. It can be turned off in the patch settings.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Stops the app from loading banner, interstitial, native and app open ads, and removes the empty space reserved for the banner.

patches.name: Hide promotions
patches.description: Stops the subscription promotion popups (discount, holiday sale and widget intro) that only free users see. Paid features are not unlocked.

patches.name: Hide review prompt
patches.description: Stops the "喜歡這個App嗎？" dialog asking to rate the app from showing.

patches.name: Hide upgrade button
patches.description: Hides the subscribe button (such as "付費移除廣告，免開app 直接查") of the search pages. It can be shown again in the patch settings.

patches.name: Patch settings
patches.description: Adds a "修補設定" page to turn the other patches on or off and adjust them while the app runs. It replaces the "廣告設定" item in the drawer's 設定 section, and is also a shortcut on the app icon.
